mentions.name: py-launch-blueprint
mentions.description: A batteries-included Python starter template that scaffolds new projects with bootstrap commands, a command runner, dev tools (Ruff for linting/formatting, MyPy for type checking, pre-commit hooks), AI-ready default configs for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code, production setup (Python 3.10+, uv package manager, testing setup), developer experience features (VS Code integration, sensible defaults, documentation), CI/CD via GitHub Actions with automatic testing and version management, task and PR templates, and license/CLA checks.
mentions.audience: A starter template aimed at giving developers a batteries-included Python project foundation.
mentions.author: SteveMorin
